$comment: Demo mode only (./demo.sh). These accounts exist only in the local Firebase Auth emulator; the password is public by design and is refused anywhere else. backend/scripts/seed_demo.py creates them and runs each review below, oldest first, so the first one in each list is the newest in My reviews. A `conversation` is replayed into Talk it through only when a Groq key is set: without the model a saved reply would be the fallback.
